overlimit.guide.item.name: OverLimit Enchant Guide
overlimit.guide.cover.heading: Over Limit
overlimit.guide.cover.body:
Effects on gear and
books are explained here.

Click an aqua name to
jump to that page.
Copy with a book and quill.
overlimit.guide.notes.title: Notes
overlimit.guide.entry.apocalypse:
Hits ignite nearby
enemies and knock them back
overlimit.guide.entry.hyper_gravity:
Roots enemies in radius 3 around the target for 3s
* No damage
CD: 6s
overlimit.guide.entry.summon_wolf:
Arrows summon a wolf.
It lasts 10s; up to 3 at once.
overlimit.guide.entry.gluttony:
Kills restore 4 hunger
(also animals and neutrals)
overlimit.guide.entry.necromancy:
Killing an unnamed enemy summons a soul of that type.
Lasts 10s
overlimit.guide.entry.impact:
Melee causes a creeper-scale blast
* No terrain damage
* You take no damage
CD: 10s
overlimit.guide.entry.absolute_field:
On melee hit taken, strongly
knock back enemies within 3
CD: 5s
overlimit.guide.entry.clairvoyance: While sneaking, hostile mobs within 32 glow.
overlimit.guide.entry.sky_walk:
Jump again in midair
* No fall damage until landing
* Not in water or while gliding
CD: 0.5s
overlimit.guide.entry.cat_foot:
Move speed ×1.2
Jump 2 blocks
Nearby creepers are passive
overlimit.guide.entry.midas_table:
Eating grants golden apple effects
* Hunger stays that of the food eaten
overlimit.guide.entry.hyper_dig:
Mining also breaks a 3×3×3 around the block
* Bedrock, chests, etc. are excluded
overlimit.guide.entry.wind_blessing: While gliding, almost all damage is negated
